script_text: Mercury Retrograde isn't a computer glitch — it's the universe filing your inner documents. When Mercury goes backward, communication turns inward, letting you rewrite old contracts you sealed long ago. For you, the signs will feel the tug of retrogrades in Houses 1st through 3rd: your self-identity stutters, your second house tells you to audit emotional assets, and your third house asks you to re-examine every belief you've absorbed from childhood. The shadow side is karmic: retrograde Mercury here echoes past lives where intellect was buried under confusion, and it reveals your North Node demanding you renegotiate unfinished business with Chiron's wounded mind before healing can begin. Survival Tip: journal three wrong decisions this cycle, list what hidden truth each one uncovered, then burn that page in a fire where no one will find it until the next Mercury station returns forward. The cosmos are calling to you right now — answer.
